g.text: Sparse samples can make a high-frequency sine look like a lower-frequency signal

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: For these uniformly spaced samples sin(2π·8tₙ)=−sin(2π·2tₙ). Alias folding includes phase/sign changes. The analog filter must reject frequencies above
the desired passband with sufficient attenuation by 5 Hz; applying it would remove the original 8 Hz component rather than recover it.
